# STD-TEC-DOC-004: Theme Styling

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-TEC-DOC-004'
standard_name: 'MkDocs Theme Styling'
standard_type: 'technology'
category: 'technology'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['technology', 'mkdocs', 'theme', 'styling', 'mandatory']
```

---

> Defines theme customization and styling standards for MkDocs documentation sites within enterprise environments. Ensures consistent visual identity, optimal user experience, and brand compliance across all enterprise documentation projects while maintaining accessibility and performance standards.

---
page_texts.3:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-004-theme-styling.md#purpose]

## Purpose

This standard establishes requirements for customizing MkDocs themes and styling within enterprise environments to ensure consistent, professional documentation sites that align with enterprise design standards and provide optimal user experience.
page_texts.5:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-004-theme-styling.md#21-standard-theme-configuration]

### 2.1 Standard Theme Configuration

**Required Theme Setup**:

```yaml
theme:
    name: material
    language: en
    direction: ltr

    # Feature configuration
    features:
        # Navigation
        - navigation.tabs
        - navigation.sections
        - navigation.expand
        - navigation.top
        - navigation.tracking
        - navigation.indexes

        # Table of contents
        - toc.integrate
        - toc.follow

        # Search
        - search.highlight
        - search.share
        - search.suggest

        # Header
        - header.autohide

        # Content
        - content.code.copy
        - content.code.annotate
        - content.tabs.link
        - content.tooltips

        # Footer
        - navigation.footer
```
page_texts.6:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-004-theme-styling.md#22-theme-variants]

### 2.2 Theme Variants

**Environment-Specific Themes**:

```yaml
# Production theme
theme:
  name: material
  custom_dir: overrides/production

# Development theme (with debugging)
theme:
  name: material
  custom_dir: overrides/development
  features:
    - content.code.select
    - content.code.annotate
```
page_texts.11:
[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-004-theme-styling.md#41-font-standards]

### 4.1 Font Standards

**Typography Configuration**:

```yaml
theme:
    font:
        text: Roboto
        code: Roboto Mono
```

**Custom Font Stack**:

```css
:root {
    --md-text-font: 'Roboto', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    --md-code-font: 'Roboto Mono', SFMono-Regular, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
}
```

[standards/technology/mkdocs/STD-TEC-DOC-004-theme-styling.md#61-css-architecture]

### 6.1 CSS Architecture

**File Organization**:

```plaintext
docs/stylesheets/
├── extra.css              # Main custom styles
├── components/
│   ├── navigation.css     # Navigation styles
│   ├── content.css        # Content area styles
│   ├── code.css          # Code block styles
│   └── forms.css         # Form elements
├── utilities/
│   ├── spacing.css       # Spacing utilities
│   ├── colors.css        # Color utilities
│   └── typography.css    # Typography utilities
└── vendor/
    └── custom-plugins.css # Third-party overrides
```
